title: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
statement: Given integer pairs, select the longest chain where each pair's first value is greater than the previous pair's second value.

title: Maximum Length of Pair Chain
statement: Given integer pairs, select the longest chain where each pair's first value is greater than the previous pair's second value.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int findLongestChain(int[][]p){Arrays.sort(p,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[1]));int last=Integer.MIN_VALUE,count=0;for(int[]x:p)if(x[0]>last){count++;last=x[1];}return count;} }

code: class Solution { public int countSubstrings(String s){int ans=0;for(int c=0;c<s.length();c++){ans+=expand(s,c,c);ans+=expand(s,c,c+1);}return ans;}private int expand(String s,int l,int r){int n=0;while(l>=0&&r<s.length()&&s.charAt(l)==s.charAt(r)){n++;l--;r++;}return n;} }

title: Replace Words
statement: Replace each word in a sentence with the shortest dictionary root that is its prefix, if such a root exists.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String replaceWords(List<String>d,String sentence){Set<String>roots=new HashSet<>(d);StringBuilder out=new StringBuilder();for(String w:sentence.split(" ")){String root=w;for(int i=1;i<=w.length();i++){String p=w.substring(0,i);if(roots.contains(p)){root=p;break;}}if(out.length()>0)out.append(' ');out.append(root);}return out.toString();} }

title: Dota2 Senate
statement: Given a string of Radiant and Dire senators, simulate bans until one party remains and return the winning party.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String predictPartyVictory(String s){Queue<Integer>r=new ArrayDeque<>(),d=new ArrayDeque<>();int n=s.length();for(int i=0;i<n;i++)(s.charAt(i)=='R'?r:d).add(i);while(!r.isEmpty()&&!d.isEmpty()){int a=r.remove(),b=d.remove();if(a<b)r.add(a+n);else d.add(b+n);}return r.isEmpty()?"Dire":"Radiant";} }

title: 2 Keys Keyboard
statement: Starting with one character, find the minimum number of copy-all and paste operations needed to obtain exactly n characters.
code: class Solution { public int minSteps(int n){int ans=0;for(int p=2;p*p<=n;p++)while(n%p==0){ans+=p;n/=p;}return n>1?ans+n:ans;} }

title: Find Duplicate Subtrees
statement: Return one root node for each distinct subtree structure and value pattern that appears more than once.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution {Map<String,Integer>ids;Map<Integer,Integer>counts;List<TreeNode>out;int next;public List<TreeNode>findDuplicateSubtrees(TreeNode root){ids=new HashMap<>();counts=new HashMap<>();out=new ArrayList<>();next=1;dfs(root);return out;}private int dfs(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return 0;String k=n.val+","+dfs(n.left)+","+dfs(n.right);int id=ids.computeIfAbsent(k,z->next++);int c=counts.getOrDefault(id,0)+1;counts.put(id,c);if(c==2)out.add(n);return id;} }

title: Two Sum IV - Input is a BST
statement: Return true if two distinct nodes in a BST have values summing to k.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public boolean findTarget(TreeNode root,int k){return dfs(root,k,new HashSet<>());}private boolean dfs(TreeNode n,int k,Set<Integer>s){if(n==null)return false;if(s.contains(k-n.val))return true;s.add(n.val);return dfs(n.left,k,s)||dfs(n.right,k,s);} }

title: Maximum Binary Tree
statement: Construct a maximum binary tree: the maximum array value is the root, with recursively built trees from the left and right subarrays.

title: Maximum Binary Tree
statement: Construct a maximum binary tree: the maximum array value is the root, with recursively built trees from the left and right subarrays.
code: class Solution { public TreeNode constructMaximumBinaryTree(int[]a){return build(a,0,a.length);}private TreeNode build(int[]a,int l,int r){if(l>=r)return null;int m=l;for(int i=l+1;i<r;i++)if(a[i]>a[m])m=i;TreeNode n=new TreeNode(a[m]);n.left=build(a,l,m);n.right=build(a,m+1,r);return n;} }

title: Robot Return to Origin
statement: Return true if a robot following U, D, L, and R moves returns to its starting position.
code: class Solution { public boolean judgeCircle(String s){int x=0,y=0;for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(c=='U')y++;else if(c=='D')y--;else if(c=='L')x--;else x++;}return x==0&&y==0;} }

title: Image Smoother
statement: For each matrix cell, replace its value with the floor of the average of itself and all valid cells among its eight neighbors.

title: Image Smoother
statement: For each matrix cell, replace its value with the floor of the average of itself and all valid cells among its eight neighbors.
code: class Solution { public int[][] imageSmoother(int[][]a){int m=a.length,n=a[0].length;int[][]out=new int[m][n];for(int r=0;r<m;r++)for(int c=0;c<n;c++){int sum=0,count=0;for(int i=Math.max(0,r-1);i<Math.min(m,r+2);i++)for(int j=Math.max(0,c-1);j<Math.min(n,c+2);j++){sum+=a[i][j];count++;}out[r][c]=sum/count;}return out;} }
